name: Metalcraft Contacts
description: Persona, skill, and HTTP API tools to read and manage a user's personal contacts / address book via Metalcraft Contacts (contacts.metalcraftai.com). One Metalcraft account owns a flat list of people, each addressed by a slug and grouped with tags: list/filter contacts, full-text search, read a contact, create/update/delete contacts (needs the write scope), see whose birthday is coming up, and set a photo from an image URL. A contact carries name, organization/title, birthday (year optional), tags, freeform markdown notes, and repeatable phones/emails/addresses/links. Authenticated by a single Metalcraft account token — METALCRAFT_TOKEN, sent as Authorization: Bearer — the same token that works across every Metalcraft ecosystem app. The API base is fixed to https://contacts.metalcraftai.com.
